column1: # Search synonyms. Rows with the same `group` mean the same thing.

# other term of that group as a search synonym (so "Ladies finger" is found by "bhindi").

# Keep terms lowercase. Avoid short words that mean other things (e.g. "sev" is apple AND a snack).
